Agent Name: Planner
Step Number: 1
Reason for Mistake: The Planner incorrectly identified "Make daily observations" (D) as the first step. In a structured scientific investigation, one must first define the method of data collection (creating a table/schema, Option C) before conducting observations. Observing without a predefined recording system leads to disorganized data. Furthermore, repeating the investigation (A) and writing a report (B) are later steps. Therefore, creating the data table (C) logically precedes making the observations (D).
